label: Structural controls for the JUSTICE_1 route to permitted divine assertion
paraphrase: Structural controls: a joint sample with a classified bearer asserting True; four premise-omission samples; JUSTICE_1 with both premises and an unwilled due act (no JUSTICE_2); and one will profile that satisfies JUSTICE_1 under the voluntarist reading but not under an independent standard. Not a possible-world witness of classical theism.
